items.t: Cruise control deactivation switch can catch fire (recall)
items.job: Disconnect or replace switch and add fused jumper harness
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Spark plug blows out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert and replace plug and coil
items.note: Price is for one cylinder. If the head must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Spark plugs seize and break during removal
items.job: Replace spark plugs and extract broken plugs
items.note: Each plug that breaks adds extraction time.

items.t: Cam phaser and timing chain rattle
items.job: Replace cam phasers, timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Cost rises if the oil pump or VCT solenoids also need replacing.

items.t: Transmission may suddenly downshift into first gear (recall)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain computer
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: EcoBoost stumble or power loss in damp weather
items.job: Replace charge air cooler and update engine software
items.note: Some trucks are fixed with only a software update and an air deflector, which costs less.

items.t: Side doors may not latch or may open while driving (recall)
items.job: Replace door latch
items.note: Price is per door. Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioners can start a fire in a crash (recall)
items.job: Remove B-pillar insulation and add heat shield
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Cam phaser rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace cam phasers and timing chain kit
items.note: Ford bulletins or warranty may help; ask a dealer with your VIN before paying.

items.t: 10-speed automatic harsh or erratic shifting
items.job: Update transmission software and run adaptive relearn
items.note: If internal parts are worn, a valve body or rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Parking brake may apply by itself (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace rear parking brake wiring harness
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor may stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace front wiper motor
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear axle hub bolt can break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear axle hub bolts
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Camera menu can cover the backup camera image (recall)
items.job: Update camera and display software
items.note: Usually free under Ford's recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Inside door handle spring can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace inside door handle
items.note: Free under recall 11V-049. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake light switch may be out of adjustment (recall)
items.job: Adjust or replace brake light switch
items.note: Free under recall 09V-150. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain stretch
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides, tensioner and phasers
items.note: Many shops replace the cam phasers at the same time.

items.t: Brake master cylinder can leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder (and booster if contaminated)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-345 or 20V-332. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Oil pan seal leak
items.job: Replace engine oil pan

items.t: Intake valves can break (recall)
items.job: Replace engine (long block) after valve failure
items.note: Free under recall 24V-635. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image can freeze or go blank (recall)
items.job: Update screen module software
items.note: Free under recall 25V-315. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Trailer brake and lights can stop working (recall)
items.job: Update trailer module software
items.note: Free under recall 26V-104. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank straps may not hold the tank (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel tank straps
items.note: Free under recall 26V-578. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine oil plug can leak quickly (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace engine oil gallery plug
items.note: Free under recall 24V-851 or 25V-198. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission valve body fault can cause loss of reverse (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission main control valve body
items.note: Free under recall 25V-164. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering gear can bind or lock (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear assembly
items.note: Free under recall 25V-022. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield may not be bonded properly (recall)
items.job: Remove and reinstall windshield
items.note: Free under recall 24V-486. Check the VIN first.
